defaultPrompt: Create an editable OCI architecture diagram using verified official Oracle toolkits.
Create a PowerPoint OCI architecture slide and validate its topology and layout.
Review this OCI diagram for service icon, boundary, routing, and readability errors.
interface.longDescription: Four discoverable skills connect workload requirements to architecture decisions and native editable OCI diagrams. Conditional references cover Well-Architected reviews, workload patterns, CAF foundations, MAA resilience, current service evidence, C4 views and decision records. QA distinguishes design reasoning, source evidence and actual artifact checks. Verified official toolkit downloads and structural validators remain available. Oracle toolkit binaries are not bundled; no Oracle endorsement is implied.

name: oci-architecture-designer
description: Design and review OCI workload architectures with requirement-based decisions, scoped primary references and editable Draw.io/PowerPoint output. Official toolkit binaries are not bundled.
